relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab and eptinezumab consistently reduced headache frequency, acute medication intake and disability, even when initiated without prior withdrawal of overused drugs.

key_findings: Review: anti-CGRP mAbs reduce headache frequency and acute medication intake in migraine with medication overuse, even without prior withdrawal.
